subject.title: fix(eval): preserve traces and reasoning controls

question: Should a native benchmark run remain leaderboard-eligible when one or more expected tasks fail before an agent attempt, even though the remaining agent attempts have canonical model identity and complete trajectories?
rationale: This is an evaluation-governance decision: excluding pre-agent failures may make agent-quality comparisons fairer, but granting full eligibility can also represent an incomplete benchmark run as complete.

options.title: Require full task coverage
options.body: Keep pre-agent infrastructure failures separately reported, but require zero such failures before a run can qualify for the leaderboard.

options.title: Allow audited partial eligibility
options.body: Permit eligibility when agent attempts are complete, but add an explicit partial-run eligibility state and make infrastructure omissions prominent in leaderboard output.

options.title: Keep the current rule
options.body: Treat pre-agent failures as outside the run’s model-evaluation contract and allow normal eligibility without an additional partial-run state.

recommendation.title: Require full task coverage
recommendation.body: Keep pre-agent infrastructure failures separately reported, but require zero such failures before a run can qualify for the leaderboard.
